## Activity

During November 2024, Oakridge Primary Care recorded 112 captures. This provides the activity total for the reporting period and indicates the volume of images available for review. The capture activity is reported for the site as a whole.

## Image quality

Of the 112 captures, 8 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 7.1. This measure records the proportion of captures that could not be used for grading and provides an indication of image quality during the month. The result should be considered alongside the overall capture activity for November 2024.

## Grading

Grading identified 13 referable results from the activity recorded at Oakridge Primary Care. The median lag between capture and grading was 5. This is the midpoint for the time taken for images to progress from capture to a completed grade during the reporting period. Together, the referable result count and median lag summarise the grading outcome and timeliness for November 2024.
